q: Is silicon metal made in Minas Gerais covered by CBAM?
title: Is silicon metal covered by CBAM?
short: No. Silicon metal, declared under CN 2804 69, is not in Annex I; the only chapter 28 element covered is hydrogen. Ferrosilicon (7202 21 and 7202 29) is not covered either: the only ferro-alloys in CBAM are ferro-manganese, ferro-chromium and ferro-nickel. Aluminium, chemical and solar buyers may still ask silicon makers for a product footprint.
audience: Silicon metal and ferrosilicon producers in Brazil and their EU customers

ul: Not covered: silicon metal and high purity silicon under 2804 61 and 2804 69.
Not covered: ferrosilicon under 7202 21 and 7202 29, and silico-manganese under 7202 30.

p: Aluminium alloy makers, silicone producers and solar wafer makers count purchased silicon in Scope 3. They want a figure per tonne that includes reductant carbon, electrodes and electricity, and evidence for any charcoal counted as biomass.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, coke, gas and electricity invoices and production records into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so the direct emissions behind each tonne can be traced to the documents. Emissions factors outside India are entered from the official source and labelled.

sources.label: European Commission, CBAM Guidance 5d: iron and steel
Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1773, Annex II (ferro-alloys: 7202 1, 7202 4 and 7202 6 only)
